description: A normal fish with no special effects.
An effect that burns the fish, potentially poisonous.
Infested with visible wriggling sea lice and tapeworms. Most of the edible meat has been ruined.
An effect that make the fish shiny, and appreciates the value of the fish.
A fish that has been dead for a few months and now is in the process of decomposing. It emits a foul odor and is covered in slime.
The fish glows with its own living light, revealing intricate glowing patterns that aquarium collectors pay handsomely for.
Covered in weeping black pustules and fungal growths. Selling it is highly discouraged due to health hazards.
Scal shift through a dazzling array of rainbow colors. Mesmerizing to look at.
A fish that has radiation, extremely toxic (DO NOT CONSUME).
A rare mutation that encrusts the fish scales with flakes of pure, deep-sea gold ore.
A fish that has transcended the physical realm, existing in a state of pure energy. It emits a radiant glow and is said to possess immense power.
